checks: three independent identities exchange contacts without resetting existing keys
all three pages reload offline before any money is created
an offer holds the source balance and shows exact signed amounts
recipient reviews the inverse amounts before agreeing
reply updates the original offer and releases change after reload
received value is sent onward to a third offline browser through the UI
repeat delivery cannot credit an onward payment twice
trade histories and reservations are encrypted at rest
trade and payment cards fit desktop and narrow layouts without clipping
phone navigation returns to people, filters names and reopens the chosen thread
a failed state commit exposes no payment and leaves balances and locks intact
simultaneous payment forms in two tabs cannot reuse the same balance
no unhandled browser errors during the complete flow
scope: Three isolated Windows Edge contexts, offline network emulation, real file handover and synthetic assets. No chain or physical-device test.
